purpose: Requalify finite atom-to-positive test pairings, not Hilbert-space evolution
test_space: V=L2_inv((1+|q|^2)^4 dmu); fields are Schwartz, clock and density factors are square integrable
error_metric: absolute complex sesquilinear pairing error; no relative error or probability interpretation
single_geometry_family: all original 33 labelled AA histories, summed completely
admissible_weight_class: nonnegative, normalized, invariant under independent swaps of the two input and output labels; weights are independent of lambda and integration variables
adversarial_weight_check: Search triples of the ten orbit responses for a positive barycentric cancellation of the paired coupling difference. This is a counterexample search over the declared admissible class, not a fourth preregistered physical measure.
single_reference_action: original uniform-labelled average Hbar, frozen across all weight comparisons
sewn_history_family: all four external boundary relabellings of each listed geometry, normalized equally; no cross-family averaging
sewn_reference_action: uniform average of the four reconstructed global Hessians within each geometry family; freeze before comparing lambda endpoints
scalar_action: H(lambda)=Hbar+lambda*(H-Hbar), lambda in {0,1}; dust and gravity unchanged
density_packet_convention: d_a=2 sum_m a_m 1_m for masks 10,01,11; input d0=2*1_00; no density strata dropped from interior measures
clock_packets: constant input and sqrt(3/2)*(t_out1+t_out2) output as exact global-clock-parity null control
quadrature_refinement_rule: If a requested nonzero classification is unresolved solely due to quadrature error, increase chain nodes to 64 once, retain both results, never classify a midpoint as nonzero
certification: exact density integrations, analytic Abel Gaussian field integrals with phase branches, positive Gauss-Legendre rules with proved Bernstein-ellipse tails, Arb/Acb outward arithmetic
global_sewing_check: Recheck all 1089 original minimal action identities independently; newly integrated sewn positive-density amplitudes concern C6/C7/C8 only
state_truncation: No field, density or clock basis projection in the directly evaluated pairings; omitted test states are outside the finite comparison, not silently bounded by sampled increments
reduced_model_check: Carry forward the existing complete forward/backward and sewing tail certificate only on its declared original class; no extension to new packets without proof
classification: NONZERO only if the certified enclosure excludes zero; otherwise UNRESOLVED. Exact structural zeros labelled EXACT_ZERO.
scope_exclusions: full positive-density integration of all 1089 histories
arbitrary CST histories or bypass completions
uniform nonzero lower bound over all normalized states
